Executive leadership directs the firm's capital directly into precious metal expansion, highlighted by a recent $40 to $50 million investment in a silver and gold recovery circuit at Greens Creek, alongside advanced drilling campaigns at the Aurora and Midas projects. This operational alignment, further reinforced by the strategic divestment of the Casa Berardi mine to concentrate on primary silver assets, dictates the company's entire business strategy and resource allocation.
